name: Rajasthan Petro Synthetics Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1983, Rajasthan Petro Synthetics Ltd is engaged in Office Management Services / C&F Agency Operations[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
RPSL used to be involved in the manufacturing and processing of fabrics/yarn, including Polypropylene Multi-Filament Yarn (PPMFY), but it was declared a sick unit and currently, it is in the business of C & F agency, office management, and transportation
